lessons.title: Thirukkural structure & authorship tradition
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of thirukkural structure & authorship tradition and apply it accurately to unfamiliar tasks.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Thirukkural mastery combines structure, couplet identification, meaning, ethical interpretation and application. Study the organisation of the work and the conceptual relationships among Aram, Porul and Inbam. When interpreting a couplet, distinguish the wording of the text from a modern paraphrase. Focus specifically on thirukkural structure & authorship tradition. Identify the key concepts, common errors, evidence or performance criteria required, and a repeatable method for improvement. Move from recognition to application: understand the task, perform it carefully, check against the stated criteria, and record the reason for any error.
examples: A Thirukkural Mastery Championship task on thirukkural structure & authorship tradition should begin by identifying the exact clue, form or performance criterion being tested.
Create a new thirukkural structure & authorship tradition example with a plausible distractor or common error, then explain the correct response or performance.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Thirukkural Mastery Championship activity on thirukkural structure & authorship tradition using practice questions, a text, oral dialogue, puzzle, writing sample or performance sample as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on thirukkural structure & authorship tradition: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent performance on the third with explicit justification or self-check.
independent_practice: Complete three unfamiliar thirukkural structure & authorship tradition tasks without viewing the solution first.
Create one new example and complete it using the lesson method.
Review one error or weak performance and state the correction rule.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Thirukkural Mastery Championship checkpoint on thirukkural structure & authorship tradition; target at least six correct or meet the stated performance standard consistently.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Thirukkural Mastery Championship task demonstrating thirukkural structure & authorship tradition and record the evidence or self-assessment used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and repeatable self-correction. Encourage independent performance before intervention. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one concrete action for improving thirukkural structure & authorship tradition.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
